ns2:section.sectionText: Coral reefs are one of the most diverse systems on earth. This diversity is reflected in the fish assemblages with over 3000 species inhabiting reef systems. These fish are reliant on the coral reefs for food and shelter but also perform and support key ecosystem functions. The course will explore the diversity and structure of reef fish assemblages along with the effects of disturbances and degradation on the fish and their habitats. Students will gain an appreciation for the challenges in implementing effective conservation strategies.
